data.title: Portrait of an Artist

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting of a mustached man with a wide-brimmed black hat and white flat collar seen from the waist up, turned to the viewer.

data.provenance_text: Presumably Prince Anatole Demidoff, Villa San Donato, near Florence (died 1870); by descent to his nephew Prince Paul Demidoff (died 1885); offered his sale, Pillet, Le Roy and Mannheim, Florence, March 15-April 10, 1880, lot 1105, engraved, bought in; by descent to Princess Demidoff (formerly Princess Lise Troubetzkoi), 1885; sold through Durand-Ruel, Paris, June 1890, as part of a group of Dutch and Flemish paintings, many from the Demidoff collection, with funds advanced by Martin A. Ryerson and other trustees of the Art Institute [annual report 1891]; the cost of 1894.1023 was reimbursed by Charles L. Hutchinson, 1894.
